downside.story: 10th percentile: a China shock (China revenue -50% = ~8.7% of FY27 revenue: entity listings or retaliation cut wireless, EI and semis test in China; ADG barely exposed) lands on top of an AI-optics digestion in which double-ordered transceiver capacity is absorbed (LightCounting: a correction is more likely than a soft landing; transceiver sales turn ~6 months before capex), so wireline capture of the optics market falls 30% below base as test buying of 1.6T lines pauses; margins fall back toward FY24-25 (CSG -4.5pt, EISG -4pt) as the tariff refund and synergy tailwinds are gone and volume leverage reverses; the market pays ~15.5x ex-SBC EPS (~17x SBC-costed, below every whole-company peer) for falling EPS; normalised EPS 15% lower. The ~6% China-Taiwan tail (Polymarket, per supervisor) sits inside this 10th percentile rather than adding to it; the October 2026 optics tape (AI-funding fears, KEYS -15.6% in the month with no downgrades) shows how quickly the multiple de-rates.

base.story: Median: the approved drivers (FY27 revenue ~8,425, FY28 ~9,334, ~33-34% non-GAAP op margin) convert as supply allows; the market pays ~22.45x SBC-costed NTM EPS at the horizon (shrunk 4-peer median, less a net 0.90 turns for a probable 2028 optics digestion and a later China rule, partly offset by a 3.2T/6G cycle), with 30% weight on mid-cycle earnings: $315.24.

upside.story: 90th percentile: supply eases by mid-2027 and the $2B+/quarter order book converts; 1.6T and 3.2T/448G R&D test plus manufacturing test and early 6G spend scale with a market still growing ~30%+ in 2028, wireline capture 25% above base; operating leverage adds 1.5-2pt of margin; the market pays ~25x ex-SBC (~27x SBC-costed, near Anritsu) because the FY29 path still grows.

reasoning: Skeptic lane. Credit is not where the risk is: net cash (-88 at Q3 FY26), BBB/positive at S&P, $700M current notes coverable from $2.6B cash; insider activity is director selling only (30k shares at $286 in March, 3k at $319 in August, $4.1M sold and $0 bought over 3 months to April), short interest only 1.3% of float, no short report found. The bear case is cyclical: KEYS earns its highest margins ever (33-34% non-GAAP op margin vs ~25% in FY24-25; FY24 revenue fell 9%) on an AI-optics ramp whose own industry analyst (LightCounting, July 2026) calls a correction more likely than a soft landing and warns of double ordering in record backlogs; the CFO says supply will be the governor and FY26 profit includes a one-time IEEPA refund; the stock fell from $389.93 to $303.50, sold off after both of the last two beats. Round 2: the supervisor showed peers are mostly SBC-costed and that my set mixed bases; I now use one basis (SBC-costed 4-peer median 23.8x: RAL, VIAV converted, AME, Anritsu; TER/FTV segment-only) converted onto each leg's ex-SBC EPS, and rebuilt the mid-cycle leg at 29% on 0.95 x NTM revenue at the peer median (the old 23x was unsupported). I add the 3.2T/6G upside I missed (net -0.90 turns vs -1.15) and the China-Taiwan tail. New in-lane evidence: October's -15.6% came with no downgrades, on AI-funding fears in optics (Broadcom/Intel CEOs), i.e. the de-rating risk is sector sentiment, which supports keeping the multiple deduction. I keep the approved drivers unchanged (3-5% above Street revenue FY27-28) and keep a fatter left tail than the supervisor. Research target (12m) $315.24 vs the Street's $418 average. Research was limited: no transcript full text; Anritsu consensus is March-FY and stale.

horizon_multiples.peer_basis: Whole-company peer median 23.8x NTM P/E, SBC-costed (RAL 21.26, VIAV 21.6 converted from 18.8 ex-SBC, AME 26.0, Anritsu 28.54; TER/FTV now segment-only). Own NTM P/E 23.24x (303.5 / 13.06 Zacks FY27, SBC expensed). Exit rule 23.8 x (23.24/23.8)^0.8 = 23.35x, less a net 0.90 turns for post-horizon risks (optics digestion 0.35 x -3 = -1.05, later China rule 0.15 x -2 = -0.30, 3.2T/6G cycle 0.30 x +1.5 = +0.45) = 22.45x SBC-costed; x 0.913 (NTM SBC 279 x 0.86 / 171.5M = $1.40 = 8.7% of the engine's ex-SBC NTM EPS 16.06) = 20.5x on the engine's ex-SBC EPS.

Normalised mid-cycle leg on the same basis as leg 1: ex-SBC mid-cycle EPS 13.21 = NTM revenue at the horizon ~9,310 x 0.95 (half of the FY24 trough-year revenue drop of ~9%) = 8,845 x 29% mid-cycle non-GAAP op margin (FY23 30.3%, FY24 26.3%, FY25 26.0%, FY26 ~32%; mean 28.7%) = 2,565 + interest on ~1,752 net cash at 4% = 70 -> 2,635 x 0.86 / 171.5M = 13.21. Multiple: the 23.8x SBC-costed peer median (no own premium, no post-horizon deduction: normalisation already carries the cycle) converted to ex-SBC: SBC 3% x 8,845 = 265 x 0.86 / 171.5 = $1.33 -> SBC-costed EPS 11.88; 23.8 x 11.88 / 13.21 = 21.4x.

downside.story: 10th percentile: a China shock (China revenue -50% = ~8.7% of FY27 revenue: entity listings or retaliation cut wireless, EI and semis test in China; ADG barely exposed) lands on top of an AI-optics digestion in which double-ordered transceiver capacity is absorbed (LightCounting: a correction is more likely than a soft landing; transceiver sales turn ~6 months before capex), so wireline capture of the optics market falls 30% below base as test buying of 1.6T lines pauses; margins fall back toward FY24-25 (CSG -4.5pt, EISG -4pt) as the tariff refund and synergy tailwinds are gone and volume leverage reverses; the market pays ~15.5x ex-SBC EPS (~17x SBC-costed, below every whole-company peer) for falling EPS; normalised EPS 15% lower. The ~6% China-Taiwan tail (Polymarket, per supervisor) sits inside this 10th percentile rather than adding to it; the October 2026 optics tape (AI-funding fears, KEYS -15.6% in the month with no downgrades) shows how quickly the multiple de-rates.

upside.story: 90th percentile: supply eases by mid-2027 and the $2B+/quarter order book converts; 1.6T and 3.2T/448G R&D test plus manufacturing test and early 6G spend scale with a market still growing ~30%+ in 2028, wireline capture 25% above base; operating leverage adds 1.5-2pt of margin; the market pays ~25x ex-SBC (~27x SBC-costed, near Anritsu) because the FY29 path still grows.

model_inputs.structure_note: Value is carried by the approved quarterly driver set (wl_capture x LightCounting optics market, wireless_rev, adg_rev, ei_rev, csg_margin, eisg_margin; unchanged) valued with a peer-anchored NTM P/E at the horizon on the build's own EPS (20.5x ex-SBC = 22.45x SBC-costed, weight 0.7) and a normalised mid-cycle P/E (stated ex-SBC EPS $13.21 x 21.4x = 23.8x SBC-costed, weight 0.3; not driver-linked). Both legs on one basis: SBC-costed peer median converted by each leg's SBC share. No DCF (policy), no SOTP. The method-fit flag (thin XBRL TTM tags) does not weaken the P/E legs: revenue and segment income come from the Ex.99.1 releases.
model_inputs.gap_note: Judgment calls for Kilian: (1) driver disagreement (not in the set): wl_capture FY28 ~8% lower (3.56% vs 3.87%) on LightCounting's correction view would cut the target ~$7; csg_margin 34-34.5% is a peak, my mid-cycle is 29% (in the normalised leg). (2) Net -0.90 turns off the exit rule (supervisor -0.75; I give the 3.2T/6G upside p 0.30 not 0.35 and the later China rule -2 turns not -1.5): -0.90 x 14.66 x 0.7 = ~-$9 (~-3%) vs no deduction, under the card threshold. (3) Anritsu in the median is a March-FY forward P/E at a 2026-10-05 price; dropping it cuts the target ~3%. (4) Mid-cycle revenue haircut 0.95 (supervisor uses none): -$5 on the target. (5) China shock probability ~12-13% within 3 years, carried in the downside case and a -0.30-turn deduction. Financing: none probable (net cash, BBB positive; p of an equity raise <5%).
model_inputs.reverse_dcf_check: 20.5x ex-SBC (22.45x SBC-costed) NTM P/E at the horizon on ~$16.06 EPS implies, at ~9-10% cost of equity, ~9-11% EPS growth for five years after FY2029 with ~33% margins held; plausible only if AI-optics and 3.2T/6G test spend keep growing through a 2028 digestion, which is why the multiple carries a net 0.90 turns off and 30% sits on mid-cycle earnings.
